title: Trailforge Studios - Resources
description: A Vanilla+ resource pack that refreshes Minecraft’s ores, gems, ingots, and other materials while preserving the original style.
body:
# Trailforge Studios - Resources

Refresh Minecraft’s materials without losing the familiar vanilla look.

**Trailforge Studios - Resources** is a Vanilla+ resource pack that redesigns ores, gems, ingots, nuggets, and other valuable materials with cleaner details and a more consistent style. Every texture is made to feel like it belongs in Minecraft while giving your collected resources a fresh and polished appearance.

Whether you are mining deep underground, organizing your storage, or displaying your rare finds, this pack gives Minecraft’s resources a subtle upgrade without changing their identity.

### Features
- Redesigned ores, gems, ingots, nuggets, and materials
- Vanilla+ style
- Clean and consistent textures
- Fits naturally into survival gameplay
- Works well alongside other Trailforge Studios packs

A simple visual refresh for the resources you collect throughout your adventures.
